_about: Real drugs with properties computed by RDKit 2026.09.1. 3D shapes are ETKDG/MMFF conformers overlaid on crystal celecoxib (3LN1) with O3A. tanimoto = Morgan2 similarity to celecoxib; shape = shape Tanimoto after overlay; clash = atoms within 2.6 A of the protein in the overlay. dock is a MOCK score built from the shape and size to behave like a real docking screen. active = known COX inhibitor in the literature (check before publication).

compounds.name: Celecoxib
compounds.note: COX-2 selective drug; the co-crystal ligand of 3LN1.

compounds.name: Fluoxetine
compounds.note: Antidepressant (SSRI); has a CF3 group like celecoxib.

compounds.name: Sildenafil
compounds.note: PDE5 inhibitor; has a sulfonyl group.

compounds.name: Furosemide
compounds.note: Diuretic; an acid with a sulfonamide, so it looks like a COX inhibitor but is not.

compounds.name: Glucose
compounds.note: Sugar; far too polar to be a drug-like hit.

compounds.name: Sulfamethoxazole
compounds.note: Antibiotic; sulfonamide on an isoxazole, like valdecoxib.

compounds.name: Paracetamol
compounds.note: Analgesic; its COX effect is weak and debated, so it is treated as inactive here.

compounds.name: 1,4-Naphthoquinone
compounds.note: Reactive quinone, a frequent false positive (PAINS).

prepDemo.name: Diclofenac sodium
prepDemo.note: Salt form: remove the counter-ion Na+ and keep the drug (as an anion at pH 7.4).

prepDemo.name: Dexibuprofen (S)
prepDemo.note: Same compound as ibuprofen but one stereoisomer: the library already has ibuprofen, so this is a near-duplicate.
